mechanism_claims.claim_text: The article frames the designed peptides within the general AMP membrane-insertion/disruption rationale, but does not directly demonstrate a single killing mechanism for the new peptides.
mechanism_claims.limitations: Background mechanism rationale only; not a direct mechanism assay for the generated peptides.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Physicochemical analysis reports positive charge and predicted alpha-helical propensity resembling known C.acnes AMPs.
mechanism_claims.limitations: Computational property support should not be promoted to direct membrane-disruption evidence.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Hemolysis and HaCaT assays provide toxicity/safety context for the potent peptides but do not establish antibacterial mechanism.
mechanism_claims.limitations: Safety assays are retained as toxicity evidence, not mechanism evidence.
